name: robots/enph353__gym-gazebo-sim
title: Gym-Gazebo-Sim CartpoleEnv-v0
intro: Gym-Gazebo-Sim CartpoleEnv-v0, adapted from enph353/gym-gazebo-sim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
